name: io.github.seekdaseek/agentfeed-mezo
title: AgentFeed on Mezo
description: Live crypto data, MUSD peg and Mezo trove health, paid per call in MUSD on Base or Mezo. One signed permit, no gas.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays, holding MUSD on NETWORK. Optional: list_routes is free and needs no key. Use a dedicated wallet with a small balance; the server never sends the key anywhere and refuses prices above MAX_PRICE_MUSD.

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: base, mezo-mainnet or mezo-testnet. Defaults to mezo-testnet (test MUSD). base and mezo-mainnet spend real MUSD.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PRICE_MUSD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any call that costs more than this many MUSD. Defaults to 0.10.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the gateway. Defaults to https://mezo.ochinimus.app
